description: Reason 109 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND', THE PRESERVED DEFECT (practice B5): a validation failure that is stored and then never read by anything, on a run that posts the transaction to two datasets out of three and completes with RETURN-CODE 0. This is the only case in the folder whose reject reason never reaches a reject record, and the only one that arranges an outcome at the repository seam rather than in its seeded data. WHY THE OUTCOME IS ARRANGED AND NOT SEEDED. 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC at :545-560 stores 109 on exactly one condition - the INVALID KEY arm of REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC at :554-559 - and that arm cannot be reached through data. The account was found by the keyed READ at :395 moments earlier and a KSDS row does not vanish between a read and a rewrite, so no selection of fixture rows can produce it. The honest place to arrange it is therefore the seam where a backend reports the condition, and CBTRN02CParityTest declares that arrangement in its own scenario table as ACCOUNT_REWRITE_NOT_FOUND rather than hiding it in this file: a BATCH_JOB case may not carry a forced outcome, because that member belongs to ParityCase.ScreenRequest and ParityCase refuses it for anything but an online case. Only the REWRITE is arranged. 0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN and the keyed read at :395 both run for real, which is the whole point: 109 is only interesting BECAUSE the account was found first, and an arrangement that broke the read as well would be arranging reason 101 instead - the arm case05 owns. THE CASCADE, AND WHY THIS RUN REACHES THE POSTING ARM AT ALL. 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF at :380-392 finds the card, so reason 100 is not set; :372-376 then performs 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT, which is the ONE genuine short-circuit in this program and the arm case04 pins. The account read at :395 succeeds, so reason 101 is not set either. Stage three at :407 asks IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL, that is 2065.00 >= 504.77, which is TRUE, so :408 CONTINUEs and no 102 is stored. Stage four at :414 asks IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10), that is '2024-12-13' >= '2022-06-10' compared as ten characters, which is TRUE, so :415 CONTINUEs and no 103 is stored. Both guards pass here, which is what makes this case a statement about the POSTING path rather than about the cascade. THE ASYMMETRY OF STAGES THREE AND FOUR IS NOT PINNED HERE AND MUST NOT BE INFERRED FROM THIS FILE: :407-413 is a complete IF/ELSE/END-IF and :414-420 is the next statement after it rather than its ELSE, so a transaction that fails BOTH has its 102 overwritten by 103 and is rejected with 0103 alone. That behaviour is owned by case06 in this folder, which fails both guards from one inline account row, and by the dedicated assertion in CBTRN02CParityTest that an overlimit AND expired transaction is rejected with 103 and never 102 (gate G31, practice B5). Nothing in this case may be read as licence to short-circuit that pair. SEED, BYTE FOR BYTE, AND ENTIRELY UNMODIFIED. Not one substituted byte anywhere: this is case01's seed, so the two cases differ only in the arrangement and the difference in their expectations is attributable to that alone. dailytran row 0 is DALYTRAN-ID 0000000000683580 on card 4859452612877065, type '01', category 0001, source 'POS TERM  ', description 'Purchase at Abshire-Lowe' padded to 100, DALYTRAN-AMT stored as the zoned image 0000005047G which is +504.77, merchant 800000000 'Abshire-Lowe' of 'North Enoshaven' at '72112     ', DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS '2022-06-10 19:27:53.000000', DALYTRAN-PROC-TS twenty-six spaces and FILLER twenty. cardxref row 20 resolves that card to XREF-CUST-ID 000000007 and XREF-ACCT-ID 00000000007, and it is the ONLY row of the fifty carrying that card. acctdata row 6 is that account and the only row carrying that ACCT-ID: ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS 'Y', ACCT-CURR-BAL 00000001930{ = 193.00, ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT 00000020650{ = 2065.00, ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT 00000002640{ = 264.00, ACCT-OPEN-DATE '2012-10-12', ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE '2024-12-13', ACCT-REISSUE-DATE '2024-12-13', both cycle amounts 00000000000{ = 0.00, ACCT-ADDR-ZIP 'A000000000', ACCT-GROUP-ID ten spaces and FILLER one hundred and seventy-eight spaces. tcatbal row 6 is key 00000000007 '01' 0001 at +0.00 with its FILLER as twenty-two ZERO characters, which is what the fixture holds rather than spaces. TRANFILE is seeded through ParityCase.DatasetInput's empty form at its declared 350 bytes and CVTRA05Y, which is a positive statement that the transaction master exists and holds no row - not an omission - so the one row it ends with is provably this run's work. ARITHMETIC, RE-DERIVABLE BY HAND FROM THE RAW BYTES WITHOUT RUNNING ANYTHING. The overpunch convention in these fixtures writes a positive final digit 0-9 as { A B C D E F G H I and a negative one as } J K L M N O P Q R. The single COMPUTE in this program, :403-405, is WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT, that is 00000000000{ minus 00000000000{ plus 0000005047G, so 0.00 - 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77. The receiver is WS-TEMP-BAL PIC S9(09)V99 at :187 and the keyword ROUNDED appears ZERO times in this program, so the store truncates: scale exactly 2 with RoundingMode.DOWN, never HALF_UP and never HALF_EVEN (gates G23, G24). WHAT POSTING DOES, IN ORDER, AND WHERE IT STOPS SHORT. Reason 0 at :211 dispatches 2000-POST-TRANSACTION, which at :425-436 moves the fourteen DALYTRAN items into their TRAN counterparts, at :437-438 composes TRAN-PROC-TS, and then performs three paragraphs in a fixed order - :440 the category balance, :441 the account, :442 the transaction master. FIRST, 2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL: the keyed read at :474 finds 00000000007 '01' 0001, so WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC stays 'N' and :495-499 selects 2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC, which at :527 adds the amount and at :528 REWRITEs. TRAN-CAT-BAL therefore moves from 0000000000{ to 0000005047G, that is 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77, and this dataset KEEPS its change. No 'TCATBAL record not found for key' line is emitted, because the record was found. SECOND, 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC: :547 adds the amount to ACCT-CURR-BAL, giving 193.00 + 504.77 = 697.77, and :548 finds DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0 so :549 adds it to ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT rather than to ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT, giving 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77. Both of those updates happen IN THE RECORD AREA, and then the REWRITE at :554 reports INVALID KEY and NEITHER REACHES THE DATASET. The expectation therefore pins ACCT-CURR-BAL at 193.00 and both cycle amounts at 0.00 - the seeded values, unchanged - and 697.77 and the moved cycle credit appear NOWHERE in this file. That contrast with case01, whose identical seed ends at 697.77 with cycle credit 504.77, is the substance of this case: an in-memory computation that a refused write discards is not an observable effect, and a translation that persisted the record area before checking the write outcome would fail here and nowhere else. THIRD, 2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE: :442 follows :441 UNCONDITIONALLY - there is no guard on WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON between them - so the transaction is written to the master even though 109 was just stored, and TRANFILE ends with one row. Two datasets out of three moved. THE DISCARD, PRECISELY. :211 tests WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0 and, finding it zero, chooses the posting arm at :212. The 109 is stored INSIDE that arm, at :556, long after the test that could have acted on it, and the mainline never looks again: the ELSE at :213-215 that adds 1 to WS-REJECT-COUNT and performs 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC is not on this path. So no reject record is composed, DALYREJS is asserted at ZERO rows on the writes channel, WS-REJECT-COUNT stays 0, the second count line reads 000000000, and :229-231 leaves RETURN-CODE at 0 because the count is not greater than zero. DO NOT ADD A BRANCH THAT REJECTS ON 109. It would be a reasonable-looking repair, it would produce a 430-byte reject and a RETURN-CODE of 4, and it would be a behaviour change (practice B5). ONE TEXT, TWO REASONS. :398 and :557 move the SAME twenty-four characters, 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND', into WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC for reason 101 and for reason 109 respectively. Only the four-digit reason distinguishes them on the wire, and on this path neither reaches the wire at all - case05 is where that text is pinned inside a reject record, as 0101 followed by the text space-padded to 76. THE 430-BYTE GEOMETRY, ASSERTED AT ZERO ROWS. :176-178 declare REJECT-RECORD as REJECT-TRAN-DATA PIC X(350) followed by VALIDATION-TRAILER PIC X(80), and :180-182 decompose the trailer as WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON PIC 9(04) followed by WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC PIC X(76): 350 + 4 + 76 = 430, exactly the DCB=(RECFM=F,LRECL=430) that app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl declares on its DALYREJS DD (gates G19, G20). The rejects generation is still opened unconditionally at :198, so the expectation declares it on the writes channel at its full 430-byte width with a row count of ZERO - which is a positive assertion that the file was created and nothing was written to it, and is a different statement from saying nothing about it. THE CLOCK IS READ HERE, AND IS PINNED. TRAN-PROC-TS is the one wall-clock-derived value in this program, and unlike every reject case in this folder this run REACHES it: Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP at :437 runs and :438 moves the composed DB2-FORMAT-TS into the twenty-six bytes of TRAN-PROC-TS. The expectation pins the harness's fixed instant, '2022-07-19-23.12.34.000000', so the case is deterministic on every run and on every machine (practice B7); a ticking clock is refused by the harness rather than tolerated. The rejected row's own DALYTRAN-PROC-TS is a separate span and stays twenty-six spaces, because nothing writes back to the daily file. FIELD FOR FIELD, NOT STRING AGAINST STRING. All five relations are pinned BOTH as a complete ordered field map, using the copybook names verbatim, AND as a whole record image. The field maps are what make a difference actionable - a failure names the dataset, the row and the copybook field rather than reporting that two long strings differ somewhere (gate G17) - and the images are what prove the total width, and therefore that every FILLER span was emitted rather than dropped, since a record missing a FILLER is short by exactly that span (gates G19, G21). Both inputs are pinned as well as the three mutable relations: reporting only what the program can change could not tell a run that left its inputs alone from one that quietly wrote to them. ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE IS MISSPELLED IN CVACT01Y - there is no T in EXPIRAION - and the misspelling is part of the contract, so it is spelled that way DELIBERATELY in the account field map; inserting the missing T would leave FieldDiffer looking for a field the decoder never produces, and the expectation would evaporate rather than fail, which is why the corrected field name appears nowhere in this file (implicit requirement I1). Signed scaled spans are pinned as decoded decimals at scale 2 and alphanumeric spans are pinned raw, with every significant trailing space preserved. SEEDING WIDTH. The cross-reference row is seeded at its true on-disk width of 36 bytes and widened to CVACT03Y's declared 50 exactly once, at SEED time, by ParityCase.Normalisation.CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 - never at comparison time, which is why the pad has a single owner (gate G16). The fourteen trailing spaces of its FILLER are the pad, and the expectation pins them so the widening is itself asserted. app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl declares a bare EXEC PGM=CBTRN02C with no PARM, so this case declares no job parameter. PROVENANCE. Every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED - by structured reading of the COBOL paragraphs cited above, cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts in app/cpy, the DD and DCB contract in app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl, and the real ASCII fixtures in app/data/ASCII. It is NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: running these programs is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime exists, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled while this program declares four ORGANIZATION INDEXED files, no Language Environment CEE* services are present so CALL 'CEE3ABD' cannot be reached, and the IBM-supplied DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR copybooks are absent from the repository. Only the PROVENANCE of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases per program, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand unchanged, and the substitution is escalated for explicit user confirmation as risk R-A rather than quietly absorbed (practice B12). RULES. No user-specified rules govern this project - review_rules returns exactly 'No user rules provided' - and their absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar. This fixture is held instead to the enterprise best-practice substitutes: B1 every value real and re-derived from the shipped fixtures with no placeholder and no invented byte, B3 the reference trees under app/cbl, app/cpy, app/jcl and app/data read and never written, B5 the stored-and-discarded 109 preserved exactly as the source produces it with no repair and no reject invented for it, B7 determinism with the one clock-derived span pinned to the harness's fixed instant, B8 explicit field-name-to-value pairs, US-ASCII throughout and money at scale 2 with RoundingMode.DOWN, B11 this derivation and the 350 + 4 + 76 = 430 arithmetic written out so a reviewer can re-check both against the copybooks by hand, and B12 this provenance stated plainly.
